messages.text: Hey, I bought the monitor stand in three credit-card instalments. I returned it already. Will the instalments complicate my refund?

Three instalments alone won’t complicate your refund: instalments of one payment count as one payment record. If that record is valid, the refund goes to the original payment. (refund-policy/v2/payment)

Would you like me to check your order and help request the refund?
